R={{FIX}}/gaw-{{SID}}; T=$R.tmp; rm -rf $R $T; mkdir -p $R $T && cd $R && git init -q && git config user.name eval && git config user.email eval@example.invalid && git config commit.gpgsign false && git commit -q --allow-empty -m init && git worktree add -q --detach .claude/worktrees/wt && W=$(cd .claude/worktrees/wt && pwd -P) && b="$T/cctoolkit-run/$(basename "$W")-$(printf '%s' "$W" | { shasum 2>/dev/null || sha1sum; } | cut -c1-8)/F1" && mkdir -p "$b" && printf 'verb: dotnet test
roots: src tests
suite: UnitTests
' > "$b/suites-green" && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R TMPDIR=$T && d(){ jq -cn --arg c "$1" '{tool_name:"Bash",session_id:"s",agent_id:"a1",agent_type:"cctoolkit:ddd-tdd-auditor",transcript_path:"",tool_input:{command:$c}}' | bash {{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh | jq -r '.hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision // "pass"'; } && echo "$(d "cd '$W' && dotnet test --project tests/X.UnitTests/X.UnitTests.csproj")|$(d 'dotnet test --project tests/X.UnitTests/X.UnitTests.csproj')"
